post.summary: Trigger immediate feed ingestion for a given source
post.description:
Dispatch a synchronous feed ingestion run for the given source.
Delegates exclusively to run_feed_ingestion — no ingestion logic lives here.
For STIX_TAXII, returns a FAILED result explaining that taxii_config is
required and must be supplied via the force-run or scheduler path.

post.description: Single entry point for all IronClaw threat detection calls. Accepts a DetectionRequest with any combination of text, url, domain, hashes, or ioc_values. Runs the full ThreatDetectionEngine pipeline: observable extraction → IOC resolution → correlation signal generation → composite scoring → verdict (allow/monitor/review/block). Persists the result to threat_detections and emits telemetry asynchronously. REVIEW and BLOCK verdicts trigger the alert bridge.

200.description: Detection completed — verdict in [allow, monitor, review, block]

400.description: Invalid request — no observable payload provided

post.description: Manually trigger ingestion for one or more threat intelligence feed sources. When STIX_TAXII is included in sources and taxii_ingest is supplied, constructs a TAXIIConfig and dispatches directly to STIXAdapter.ingest_from_taxii(). All other sources are dispatched to the standard feed ingestion service. When use_scheduler=true and the source is registered in the scheduler, delegates to force_feed_run() for a fully audit-persisted, scheduler-tracked forced run.

parameters.name: use_scheduler

schema.description: When true, delegate to the scheduler's force_feed_run() for sources registered in the scheduler (MITRE_ATTACK, CISA_KEV). Produces a full SchedulerRunRecord persisted to feed_ingest_log. Has no effect on STIX_TAXII sources.
schema.title: Use Scheduler

parameters.description: When true, delegate to the scheduler's force_feed_run() for sources registered in the scheduler (MITRE_ATTACK, CISA_KEV). Produces a full SchedulerRunRecord persisted to feed_ingest_log. Has no effect on STIX_TAXII sources.

get.description: Returns the current status of the background threat feed scheduler, including per-source schedule entries, recent run history, total run/failure counts, and prune configuration.

post.description: Accepts full TAXII 2.1 connection parameters and dispatches directly to STIXAdapter.ingest_from_taxii(). Returns a FeedIngestResult with per-page IOC insert/update/skip/error counts and ingest metadata.

Sweeps the threat_detections history for matching IOC values, MITRE technique IDs, CVE identifiers, or risk families within an optional time window. Accepts a HuntQuery with any combination of hunt criteria. Returns a HuntResult with status, total_matches, and a list of HuntMatch objects. Telemetry is emitted and alert bridge triggered asynchronously on completion with matches.

400.description: Invalid request — no hunt criteria provided

get.description: Returns the full DetectionResult for a previously stored detection event. Returns 404 if the event_id is not found in threat_detections. Returns 503 if the Supabase client is unavailable.

post.summary: Run threat detection on multiple event payloads
post.description: Accepts a list of DetectionRequest payloads (max 50) and returns a DetectionResult for each. Each event is detected independently through the full ThreatDetectionEngine pipeline. Useful for bulk screening of tool call plans, session histories, or multi-step agent outputs. Results are persisted and telemetry is emitted asynchronously.

200.description: All detections completed — individual verdicts per event

400.description: Batch exceeds 50 events or contains invalid requests

500.description: Detection engine error on one or more events
